## Experience

### Undergraduate Researcher — University of Illinois Chicago

August 2025–Present, Prof. Debjit Pal's group.

Coauthored BoostedSOSA, a dual-FPGA HPC scheduler using ML predictions of job
runtime. The team's paper reports up to 63.85% lower prediction error than
user estimates and an average 17× speedup over an AVX-optimized software
baseline. Currently implementing two zero-copy, lock-free host–FPGA ring
buffers to replace flag polling. The integration is still in progress.

Paper: BoostedSOSA: Accelerated Inferencing for Low Variance Stochastic
Online Scheduling. Adam H. Ross, Riccardo Revalor, Aryan Singh, Ayush Jain,
and Debjit Pal. arXiv preprint, August 2026.
https://arxiv.org/html/2608.25346v1

### Software Engineering Intern — University of Illinois Chicago

May–August 2025.

Converted batch-oriented FPGA I/O into a free-running streaming pipeline.
Built nonblocking Vitis HLS Reader/Writer kernels and multithreaded C++/XRT
host I/O. Verified the systolic datapath, virtual FIFO, and cost calculator
with roughly 1,100 lines of Monte Carlo-driven Vitis HLS tests on Alveo U55C.

## Selected work and skills

- Linux homelab and production infrastructure: public websites and projects
  serving 30K+ monthly unique visitors and 1M+ requests per month on a
  three-node HA K3s/Proxmox cluster. Ansible, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana,
  OPNsense, and Cloudflare mTLS.
- CUDA GPT-2 inference engine: GPU kernel development and profiling on a
  four-person team.
- C systems projects: memory allocator, epoll network server, POSIX shell,
  parallel make, and filesystem work.
- Full stack development: TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, React, Spring Boot,
  PostgreSQL, and SQLite. Freeway LLM gateway and EnvSync secret sharing.
- Languages and tools: C, C++, Python, Rust, Java, TypeScript, SQL, Bash,
  Linux/UNIX, POSIX, CUDA, Vitis HLS, XRT, Nsight, GDB, and Git.
